description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and responsible **E\-Commerce Marketplace Executive** to independently manage and grow our online marketplace business across **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho and other e\-commerce platforms**.

The ideal candidate should have practical, hands\-on experience with marketplace seller panels and should be capable of managing **product listings, catalogues, images, inventory, pricing, promotions and marketplace advertising**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketplace Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day operations on **Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, Myntra, Meesho Supplier Panel** and other marketplaces.
* Create, update and maintain product listings and catalogues.
* Manage product titles, descriptions, bullet points, keywords, attributes, specifications and pricing.
* Create new ASINs/SKUs/catalogues and manage product variations.
* Upload and maintain product images, videos and A\+ / enhanced content wherever applicable.
* Ensure all listings are accurate, complete and marketplace\-compliant.

**Product Images \& Content**

* Create, edit, resize and optimize product images as per marketplace requirements.
* Use **Canva, Photoshop or AI tools** to create/edit product images, banners and marketplace creatives.
* Generate or improve product content using AI tools wherever appropriate.
* Maintain consistency of product information and images across all marketplaces.

**Advertising \& Promotions**

* Manage **Amazon Ads/PPC, Flipkart Ads, Meesho Ads** and other marketplace advertising.
* Create and manage Auto and Manual campaigns.
* Monitor **ROAS, ACOS, CPC, CTR, conversion rate and advertising sales**.
* Identify poor\-performing campaigns/products and optimize or pause them.
* Manage coupons, deals, discounts and promotional campaigns.
* Suggest products and keywords that have potential for higher sales.

**Inventory \& Operations**

* Monitor stock levels and ensure products remain available for sale.
* Coordinate with warehouse/operations team for stock and order\-related issues.
* Monitor orders, cancellations, returns, refunds and other marketplace issues.
* Identify listing, inventory or order errors and resolve them quickly.

**Marketplace Account Health**

* Monitor seller/account health and marketplace performance metrics.
* Handle suppressed, inactive, blocked or error listings.
* Raise support cases with Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho etc. and follow up until resolution.
* Keep track of marketplace policies and compliance requirements.

**Reporting \& Analysis**

* Prepare regular marketplace sales and performance reports.
* Track SKU\-wise sales, revenue, returns, cancellations, advertising spend and profitability.
* Analyse marketplace data and identify opportunities to improve sales and margins.
* Maintain accurate Excel/Google Sheets reports.

**Requirements**

* **1–3 years of hands\-on experience in e\-commerce marketplace management.**
* Prior experience with **Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub is mandatory.**
* Experience with **Myntra and Meesho** will be strongly preferred.
* Practical knowledge of product listing and catalogue creation.
* Experience managing marketplace advertising/PPC is preferred.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets**.
* Knowledge of Canva, Photoshop or similar image\-editing tools.
* Comfortable using AI tools for content and creative generation.
* Good understanding of marketplace SEO, keywords and product optimization.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of marketplace operations.

**Preferred Candidate**

Candidates who have previously managed **multiple marketplaces independently** will be preferred.

Experience in managing a complete marketplace operation — from **catalogue creation → listing → images/content → inventory → pricing → advertising → sales analysis → returns/issues** — will be a major advantage.

**Important**

**This is not a basic data\-entry or listing\-uploading job.**

We are looking for someone who can **take ownership of marketplace operations and contribute towards increasing sales and improving marketplace performance.**

**Salary**

**18000 – 28,000 month**, depending on practical experience, marketplace knowledge and advertising skills.

**Higher salary can be considered for exceptional candidates with strong Amazon/Flipkart Ads, catalogue management and marketplace growth experience.**
